title: The terminal offers a “guaranteed rate”
scenario: A shop terminal abroad asks whether to pay in your home currency or local currency. The cashier says the home-currency option is “guaranteed” and points to a rate on the screen that looks reassuring.

answers.A: Compare the offered conversion and usually choose local currency so your card issuer handles conversion under its terms.
answers.B: Ask the cashier to cancel and show the amount again in local currency before approving anything.
answers.C: Choose home currency because seeing the final amount removes exchange-rate uncertainty.

explanation: Dynamic currency conversion can add a poor exchange rate or markup. The important action is understanding who sets the conversion.
proTip: Choose the currency with eyes open, not because the terminal calls it convenient.
